title: SwearWordsOFF
description: A lightweight Minecraft plugin that blocks swear words and lets you reload the config with a simple command.
body:
SwearWordsOFF - Keep Your Minecraft Chat Clean and Friendly!

SwearWordsOFF is a powerful and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin designed to automatically detect and block offensive language in your server chat. Perfect for community server! and family friendly environments, this plugin helps maintain a positive and respectful chat by filtering out swear words and inappropriate language in real-time.

How to use:
- Start By Downloading The Plugin from here then go to your plugins folder - then drag the plugin into the plugins folder.

- Restart Your Minecraft Server
 
- Go to the config.yml to change the blacklisted words people should not be able to type
 
- Type /swearwordsoff reload 

AND NOW YOU ARE READY TO GO

----

**Permissions:**
Config Reload: swearwordsoff.reload
